dedupe_keys.name: fbg simul fibre bragg grating sensor simulator

description: FBG_SiMul calculates the reflected signal of a fibre Bragg grating sensor from structural stress and strain fields. Its contributors provide Python code and a standalone Windows version, together with tutorial data in the project repository. The SoftwareX article describes a modified transfer-matrix method and an empirical check. A modeller supplies the finite-element field, fibre placement and load history; structural extent, sensor spacing and time coverage depend on that case. It can test sensor layout and synthetic observations for structural-health monitoring of bridges, buildings or other assets. The current GitHub repository is public without a fee and states GPL-3.0. The journal archive links the same upstream project. A limitation is that an optical signal calculation does not itself establish a sensor calibration or the damage state of a structure. No related catalogue record was identified. No finite-element file, executable or sensor was used. The simulated optical signal can support a structural digital twin.
